resource_title: Cobertura geográfica de la EPH a nivel de radio censal
census_basis: Censo Nacional de Población, Hogares y Viviendas 2010
attribution: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Censos (INDEC)

historical_evidence.note: Historical notebooks are regression evidence only. They spatially reconstructed radio-to-agglomerate membership and are not authority for A7.

consumer_evidence.note: Read-only compatibility target: existing optional AGLOMERADO geography column can reference native EPH agglomerate codes without GIS logic.

known_limitations: The published radio coverage is explicitly based on Census 2010 cartography; it is not a Census 2022 geography.
The published layer is a survey-frame geography, not a claim that the same frame definition applies unchanged to every historical EPH quarter.

INDEC documentation reports review of geographic coverage after 2016 and incorporation of previously missing areas into regular fieldwork during 2018, affecting estimates from first quarter 2019; users must match survey vintage to applicable frame documentation.
The official radio source directly carries agglomerate membership and must be preferred over a reconstructed spatial overlay.
Three official radio identities have no geometry in either distributed vector format and remain valid tabular frame rows.
Native agglomerate code 38 is published with two spelling variants; the release preserves source name values rather than inventing a canonical spelling.
